title: Documentation audit and rewrite for interactive data components and token semantics
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: perform a focused audit and rewrite of the design system documentation for interactive data components (tables, charts, expandable rows, action buttons) and the underlying token semantics (spacing density, focus/hover states, color intents). The current docs are fragmented between API reference pages and example galleries; this ticket consolidates usage guidance, explicit do/don't examples, migration notes for v-next token changes, and updated component API docs with small code snippets and prop guidance. Deliverables: 1) unified 'Interactive Data Pattern' landing doc that links to per-component usage pages, 2) per-component sections with clear API surface, recommended usage patterns, accessibility notes and performance considerations, 3) migration guide for teams upgrading to new token names and density tokens, 4) a short annotated examples gallery (light and dark, compact and spacious), 5) PRs to update the docsite and storybook examples.
acceptance_criteria: Landing doc published under Docs > Patterns > Interactive Data that summarizes recommendations and links to components
Buttons/Tables/Charts pages updated to include a 'When to use' and 'When not to use' section with 2-4 concrete examples each
Token migration guide with mapping table and a small codemod example added to the migration section
All code snippets linted and validated in storybook; visual tests added for the new example variants
PRs reviewed by PM and Eng and merged to docs branch; docsite preview shows changes
